name: Identity Pack 20 — Higgsfield / Soul ID dataset
description: Twenty individual photoreal frames of one person, designed as a training + driving dataset for avatar video. Covers the full yaw sweep (front → 3/4 → profile → back), three framing scales (close-up / medium / full-height), the expression range a lip-sync model needs (neutral, soft smile, broad smile, mid-speech), seated and standing body language, and three work/lifestyle contexts with the face never occluded. Twenty is not arbitrary: it is the documented minimum for a Higgsfield Soul ID training set, and this breakdown satisfies its three quality rules — varied angles, varied expressions, at least one full-height frame for body proportions.
output_rule: Each shot is written to its own image file. Never composite, collage, contact-sheet or grid the set.

groups.A_identity_core: Face lock. Same lighting setup, same wardrobe, same background across all six. This block is what the identity model actually learns from — keep every variable except head yaw and expression frozen.
groups.B_expression_speech: Expression and mouth range. Feeds lip-sync and talking-head models, which fail when every reference frame has a closed, static mouth.
groups.C_body_proportions: Height, build, silhouette and hair from every side. Full-height frames are what stop a video model from inventing new body proportions between shots.
groups.D_pose_context: Seated and standing body language in the avatar's own environment.
groups.E_work_lifestyle: Real situations. Varied light and wardrobe layers, face always clear — these teach the model the person in context without polluting the identity signal.

shots.framing: close-up, head and top of shoulders, eyes on the upper third line
shots.camera: 85mm equivalent, f/2.8, camera at eye level, subject 1.5 m from lens
shots.head: facing the lens straight on, 0° yaw, 0° tilt
shots.expression: relaxed neutral, lips closed but not pressed, jaw unclenched
shots.purpose: The anchor frame. Every other frame in the pack is judged against this one for identity drift.
shots.purpose_es: La toma ancla. Todas las demás se comparan con esta para detectar deriva de identidad.

shots.framing: close-up, head and top of shoulders
shots.camera: 85mm equivalent, f/2.8, camera at eye level
shots.head: turned 35° to her left, both eyes fully visible, far eye not clipped by the nose
shots.expression: soft closed-lip smile, slight crease at the outer corners of the eyes
shots.purpose: Primary three-quarter. The single most-used angle in avatar video.
shots.purpose_es: El tres cuartos principal. El ángulo más usado en video de avatar.

shots.framing: close-up, head and top of shoulders
shots.camera: 85mm equivalent, f/2.8, camera at eye level
shots.head: turned 35° to her right, both eyes fully visible
shots.purpose: Mirror of shot 02. Faces are asymmetric; without both sides the model averages them into a face that matches neither.
shots.lighting_override: mirror the key so it stays on the near cheek
shots.purpose_es: Espejo de la 02. Las caras son asimétricas; con un solo lado el modelo promedia una cara que no se parece a ninguno.

shots.framing: close-up, head and neck
shots.camera: 85mm equivalent, f/4, camera at eye level
shots.head: full 90° profile facing frame-left, nose tip clear of the far cheek line
shots.gaze: level, straight ahead, not at the lens
shots.purpose: Locks nose bridge, chin projection, jaw angle and ear shape — the features a front view cannot describe.
shots.lighting_override: reposition the key to rake across the profile, keeping the nose shadow short and soft
shots.purpose_es: Fija el puente de la nariz, la proyección del mentón, el ángulo de la mandíbula y la oreja — lo que una vista frontal no puede describir.

shots.framing: close-up, head and neck
shots.camera: 85mm equivalent, f/4, camera at eye level
shots.head: full 90° profile facing frame-right
shots.purpose: Completes the yaw sweep. With 01–05 the model has the head at 0°, ±35° and ±90°.
shots.lighting_override: mirror the key so it rakes across the profile from the other side
shots.purpose_es: Cierra el barrido de ángulos. Con 01–05 el modelo tiene la cabeza a 0°, ±35° y ±90°.

shots.framing: close-up, head and top of shoulders
shots.camera: 85mm equivalent, f/2.8, camera at eye level
shots.head: facing the lens, 0° yaw
shots.expression: broad genuine smile, upper teeth visible, real Duchenne creasing around the eyes, cheeks lifted
shots.purpose: Upper bound of the expression range, and the frame that fixes tooth shape and smile-line geometry so they stop changing between generations.
shots.purpose_es: El techo del rango de expresión, y la toma que fija la forma de los dientes y las líneas de sonrisa para que dejen de cambiar entre generaciones.

shots.label_es: Plano medio, mirada fuera de cámara
shots.framing: medium shot, waist up, subject slightly off-centre with lookroom on the side she faces
shots.camera: 50mm equivalent, f/2.8, camera at eye level
shots.head: turned 20° off axis
shots.gaze: off camera toward the lookroom side, eyes not to the lens
shots.purpose: Non-eye-contact reference. Without it, avatar video locks into an unbroken stare at the viewer.
shots.purpose_es: Referencia sin contacto visual. Sin ella, el avatar se queda mirando fijo a cámara todo el rato.

shots.framing: medium shot, chest up
shots.camera: 50mm equivalent, f/2.8, camera at eye level
shots.head: facing the lens, 10° yaw
shots.expression: caught mid-sentence, mouth open on a vowel, teeth partly visible, eyebrows slightly raised, animated but not exaggerated
shots.gaze: into the lens, as if addressing the viewer
shots.purpose: The frame most avatar datasets forget. Lip-sync models trained only on closed mouths produce a rubbery, pasted-on mouth in video.
shots.purpose_es: La toma que casi todos los datasets olvidan. Un modelo entrenado solo con bocas cerradas produce una boca de goma, pegada, en video.

shots.label_es: Plano medio frontal, manos visibles y gesto natural
shots.label_en: Medium shot, front, hands in frame
shots.framing: medium shot, waist up, both hands inside the frame and clear of the face
shots.camera: 50mm equivalent, f/2.8, camera at eye level
shots.head: facing the lens
shots.purpose: Fixes hand size, skin tone continuity between hand and face, and nail styling — the details that betray a synthetic avatar the moment it gestures.
shots.purpose_es: Fija el tamaño de las manos, la continuidad de tono entre mano y cara, y las uñas — los detalles que delatan un avatar sintético en cuanto gesticula.

shots.framing: full height, head to feet, small margin above the head and below the shoes
shots.camera: 35mm equivalent, f/4, camera at chest height so perspective does not stretch the legs
shots.head: facing the lens
shots.pose: standing straight, weight evenly distributed, arms relaxed at her sides
shots.purpose: The mandatory full-height frame. This is what a video model reads for height, build and limb proportion.
shots.lighting_override: open the key up to cover the full figure evenly, floor to head
shots.purpose_es: El plano de cuerpo entero obligatorio. Es lo que un modelo de video lee para altura, complexión y proporción de las extremidades.

shots.framing: full height, head to feet
shots.camera: 35mm equivalent, f/4, camera at chest height
shots.head: body turned 40° to her left, head turned back toward the lens
shots.pose: standing, weight on the back leg, front shoulder slightly forward
shots.purpose: Three-quarter body volume — shoulder depth and hip line, unreadable from a flat front view.
shots.lighting_override: open the key up to cover the full figure
shots.purpose_es: Volumen del cuerpo en tres cuartos — profundidad de hombros y línea de cadera, ilegibles desde un frontal plano.

shots.framing: full height, head to feet
shots.camera: 35mm equivalent, f/4, camera at chest height
shots.head: body turned 40° to her right, head turned back toward the lens
shots.pose: standing, weight on the back leg
shots.purpose: Mirror of 11.
shots.lighting_override: mirror the key and open it up to cover the full figure
shots.purpose_es: Espejo de la 11.

shots.framing: full height, head to feet
shots.camera: 35mm equivalent, f/4, camera at chest height
shots.head: full 90° side view facing frame-left, head in line with the body
shots.gaze: straight ahead, not at the lens
shots.pose: standing straight, arms relaxed, natural posture with no forced military stance
shots.purpose: Silhouette depth: posture, chest-to-back depth, how the hair sits off the shoulders.
shots.lighting_override: rake the key from the camera side so the silhouette edge stays readable
shots.purpose_es: Profundidad de silueta: postura, fondo del torso, cómo cae el pelo sobre los hombros.

shots.framing: full height, head to feet
shots.camera: 35mm equivalent, f/4, camera at chest height
shots.head: full 90° side view facing frame-right
shots.purpose: Mirror of 13. Completes the 360° body turnaround with shot 15.
shots.lighting_override: mirror the key, raking from the camera side
shots.purpose_es: Espejo de la 13. Con la 15 completa el giro de 360° del cuerpo.

shots.framing: full height, head to feet, seen from directly behind
shots.camera: 35mm equivalent, f/4, camera at chest height
shots.head: facing away from the lens, face not visible
shots.pose: standing straight, arms relaxed at her sides
shots.purpose: Back of the head, hair length and fall, shoulder width. Required for any camera move that orbits the avatar.
shots.lighting_override: key from the camera side, soft, full figure
shots.purpose_es: Nuca, largo y caída del pelo, ancho de hombros. Imprescindible para cualquier movimiento de cámara que orbite al avatar.

shots.framing: medium-long shot, head to mid-calf, seated
shots.camera: 50mm equivalent, f/2.8, camera at seated eye level
shots.head: turned toward the lens, body 30° off axis
shots.pose: seated on a simple stool or chair, back straight but not stiff, hands resting on her thigh, knees angled away from the lens
shots.background: her own work environment, softly out of focus
shots.purpose: Seated posture. Interview and testimonial video is shot seated; a dataset of only standing frames renders a seated avatar with broken proportions.
shots.purpose_es: Postura sentada. Las entrevistas y testimoniales se graban sentados; un dataset solo de pie renderiza mal al avatar sentado.

shots.label_es: De pie, postura relajada, en su entorno
shots.framing: full height, head to feet, environment readable around her
shots.camera: 35mm equivalent, f/2.8, camera at chest height
shots.head: facing the lens
shots.pose: standing with weight on one hip, one hand loose at her side, the other resting lightly on a surface, shoulders open
shots.background: her own work environment, full depth
shots.purpose: The hero standing frame — natural contrapposto rather than the passive T-pose of shot 10.
shots.purpose_es: La toma héroe de pie — contraposto natural, no la pose pasiva de la 10.

shots.label_es: Trabajo: atendiendo a una clienta, rostro despejado
shots.label_en: Work: consulting with a client, face clear
shots.framing: medium shot, subject in the foreground, the other person turned away from the lens or cropped out
shots.camera: 35mm equivalent, f/2.2, camera at eye level
shots.head: three-quarter to the lens
shots.gaze: off camera toward the person she is talking to
shots.pose: leaning in slightly, hands gesturing below chin level and clear of the face
shots.purpose: Professional context. The second person must never occlude the avatar's face or compete for focus.
shots.purpose_es: Contexto profesional. La segunda persona nunca debe tapar el rostro del avatar ni competir por el foco.

shots.label_es: Trabajo: haciendo su oficio, manos ocupadas, rostro visible
shots.label_en: Work: hands on the craft, face visible
shots.framing: medium shot, hands working inside the frame but well below the chin
shots.camera: 50mm equivalent, f/2.2, camera at eye level
shots.head: tilted slightly down toward the task, chin lifted enough that the whole face stays visible to the lens
shots.purpose: Downward-gaze reference with no occlusion. Hard constraint: hands, tools and product never cross the jawline.
shots.purpose_es: Referencia de mirada baja sin oclusión. Regla dura: manos, herramientas y producto nunca cruzan la mandíbula.

shots.label_es: Lifestyle: fuera del trabajo, luz de ventana
shots.framing: medium close-up, chest up
shots.camera: 50mm equivalent, f/2.0, camera at eye level
shots.head: three-quarter, turned slightly toward the window
shots.expression: relaxed, unposed, a small private smile
shots.gaze: off camera, out of the window
shots.pose: seated at a café or kitchen table, forearms on the table, shoulders dropped
shots.background: café or home interior, soft depth
shots.purpose: One frame under genuinely different light. It teaches the model how her skin tone behaves outside the studio setup, which is what keeps her from looking like a cutout when composited into a new scene.
shots.lighting_override: a single large window to one side, the far cheek falling into open shade with no fill card
shots.purpose_es: Una toma con luz de verdad distinta. Enseña cómo se comporta su piel fuera del set, que es lo que evita que parezca un recorte al componerla en otra escena.

groups_es.A_identity_core: Bloqueo del rostro. Misma luz, mismo vestuario, mismo fondo en las seis. Este bloque es del que el modelo aprende la identidad: congela todas las variables salvo el giro de cabeza y la expresión.
groups_es.B_expression_speech: Rango de expresión y de boca. Alimenta el lip-sync y los modelos de talking head, que fallan cuando todas las referencias tienen la boca cerrada y quieta.
groups_es.C_body_proportions: Altura, complexión, silueta y pelo desde todos los lados. Los planos de cuerpo entero son lo que impide que un modelo de video se invente proporciones nuevas entre tomas.
groups_es.D_pose_context: Lenguaje corporal sentada y de pie, en su propio entorno.
groups_es.E_work_lifestyle: Situaciones reales. Luz y capas de vestuario variadas, rostro siempre despejado — enseñan a la persona en contexto sin contaminar la señal de identidad.
